start: A gym member on the welcome, online, with the gym code from the desk

user_sees: 'Join your gym'
'Scan the poster at your gym'
'or type the gym code'
must_not: The camera opened without a tap

user_sees: 'Checking the code…'
'<Gym> found. Its join screen opens right after setup.'
Button 'Join <Gym>'
must_not: A wrong code told only after setup

user_sees: The gym's join screen, asking before anything is joined
must_not: The gym joined without asking
The kept code lost

start: A gym member at the gym's front desk

user_sees: The camera; 'Close the camera'
must_not: The typing box hidden for good

user_sees: The code filled in and checked as if typed
must_not: Another QR read as a gym code

start: A gym member typing a code

steps.action: Type 4 letters and tap 'Join my gym'
user_sees: 'The code is 6 letters or numbers. Ask at your gym's desk.'
must_not: The short code kept

steps.action: Type a 6-letter code no gym has
user_sees: 'No gym has the code <CODE>. Check the code with your gym's desk and type it again.'
must_not: The wrong code kept

steps.action: Tap 'Scan the poster' and refuse the camera
user_sees: 'MettleUp is not allowed to use your camera, so type your gym's code below instead.'
must_not: A crash or the camera asked on every tap

start: A gym member with a code kept

user_sees: An empty box with the keyboard up
must_not: The old gym still kept

steps.action: Turn the internet off and type the code
user_sees: 'Gym code <CODE> saved. Your gym's join screen opens right after setup.'
must_not: Setup blocked until online

start: A gym member typing the gym code

steps.action: Read the line under the box
user_sees: 'Your gym gives you a code to check in and order from its shop. Your workouts stay on this phone.'
must_not: Workouts sent to the gym by keeping the code

steps.action: Keep the code and finish setup
user_sees: The gym's join screen asks before anything is shared
must_not: The gym told about the member before the join screen
